title: कक्षा ३ को मेरो नेपाली पाठ्यपुस्तकमा प्रयुक्त कविताहरुको विश्लेषणात्मक अध्ययन { Kakshya Tinko Mero Nepali Pathyapustakma Prayukta Kabitaharuko Bishleshanatmak Adhyayan}
nepali: शोधशीर्षक 	 कक्षा तिनको मेरो नेपाली पाठ्यपुस्तकमा प्रयुक्त कविताहरुको विश्लेषणात्मक अध्ययन शोधार्थी  		मेनुका कोइराला शोधनिर्देशक	अर्जुनप्रसाद पौडेल क्याम्पस		सिन्धुली बहुमुखी क्याम्पस, ढुङ्ग्रेबास शैक्षिक सत्र	२०६४÷६६ अध्याय		पाँच पृष्ठ संख्या	९+४५+२  शोधको उद्देश्य क) कक्षा तिनमा प्रयुक्त कविता विधा समावेश गरिनुको उपयुक्ततावारे स्पष्ट पार्नु, ख) समाविष्ट कविताहरुलाई विषयवस्तु, शब्दभण्डार चयन, पाठ्क्रमअनुरुपता र नमुना अभ्यासका दृष्टिले विश्लेषण गर्नु  निष्कर्ष  यस शोधपत्रको पहिलो अध्यायमा शोध परिचय प्रस्तुत गरिएको छ । दोश्रो अध्यायमा पाठ्क्रम अनुरुपताका दृष्टिले कविताको विश्लेषण गरिएको छ । अध्याय तेश्रोमा पाठ्पुस्तकमा प्रयुक्त कविताहरुको संरचनात्मक विश्लेषण गरिएको छ । चोथौ अध्यायमा नमुना अभ्यासको अध्ययन गरिएको छ भने पाचौ तथा अन्तिम अध्यायमा निष्कर्ष तथा सुझावहरु दिइएको छ ।
american_english: Research title: An analytical study of poems used in the Nepali textbook of class three. Researcher: Menuka Koirala. Research director: Arjunprasad Poudel. Campus: Sindhu Multiple Campus, Dhungrebash. Academic session: 2064/66. Chapters: five. Number of pages: 9 + 45 + 2. Objectives of the research: a) To clarify the appropriateness of including the poem genre in class three, b) To analyze the included poems from the point of view of subject matter, vocabulary selection, curriculum conformity and sample practice. Conclusion: In the first chapter of this research paper, research introduction has been presented. In the second chapter, the analysis of poems has been done from the point of view of curriculum conformity. In the third chapter, structural analysis of poems used in the textbook has been done. In the fourth chapter, the study of sample practice has been done, and in the fifth and final chapter, conclusions and suggestions have been given.

informal_english: So this research is titled 'An analytical study of poems used in the Nepali textbook of class three.' Menuka Koirala did it, directed by Arjunprasad Poudel, out of Sindhu Multiple Campus, Dhungrebash, in 2064/66. It's five chapters, 9 plus 45 plus 2 pages. The aims: a) to clarify the appropriateness of including the poem genre in class three, and b) to analyse the included poems from the point of view of subject matter, vocabulary selection, curriculum conformity and sample practice. The conclusion: the first chapter presents the research introduction, the second analyses poems from the point of view of curriculum conformity, the third does structural analysis of poems used in the textbook, the fourth studies sample practice, and the fifth and final chapter gives conclusions and suggestions.
